the addition of fly ash and fibers in concrete enhances the Impact strength.
the impact resistance of concrete can be improved by using steel fibers and replacement of cement by fly ash.

the development of new concrete materials with enhanced Impact resistance by using steel fibers and partial replacement of flyash.
the development of a new class of concrete, flyash concrete, reinforced with steel fibers, which has the ability to resist impact loading.

the use of flyash in concrete and steel fiber reinforcement in concrete can improve the Impact strength of concrete and the combination of the two can be used for the development of high strength Impact resistant concrete.
flyash concrete reinforced steel fibers are found to be more effective than the conventional steel fiber reinforced concrete.
the use of steel fibers in concrete can be used for the improvement of impact resistance of concrete.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
flyash concrete reinforced by steel fiber can be used for the construction of pavements, runways of airport, bridges, etc. where the impact resistance of concrete is required.
the Impact resistance of concrete can be enhanced by providing steel fibers in concrete.
, the use of steel fiber in the flyash concrete would enhance the Impact strength of the concrete and it would be possible to use more steel fiber in the concrete for enhancing the Impact strength.

the use of steel fibers in concrete is a very effective way to increase Impact strength.
the Impact strength of flyash concrete can be improved by the addition of steel fiber.
